tool.name: run_source_sustainability
tool.description: 把已核实的评价 JSON 委托给部署绑定的外部服务执行水源地可持续利用综合评价；算法不在平台内复现。Executor 仅连接固定 HTTPS 主机，校验服务、API、模型与操作版本白名单，并对输入、结构化结果和下载文件执行可审计的 SHA256 完整性绑定。

sustainability-result.title: 水源地综合评价结构化结果

semantics.description: External groundwater-sustainability service structured value returned for the allowlisted sustainability.evaluate operation; valuesSha256 in the run receipt binds its canonical JSON bytes.
limitations: The scoring algorithm is not locally reproduced or independently validated by the platform.
This non-regulatory result cannot replace scientific review, administrative approval or a formal regulatory decision.
semantics.source: external groundwater-sustainability service; exact service/model versions are recorded in sustainability-run-receipt

sustainability-result-file.title: 水源地综合评价 JSON 文件

semantics.description: Remote result download whose declared media type, format, size and SHA256 are verified before the bytes are published; the matching identity is recorded in the run receipt.
limitations: Byte integrity and transport verification do not establish scientific validity, completeness of the submitted assessment or reproducibility of the external algorithm.
Remote result content may contain service-generated timestamps or other variable metadata.
semantics.source: external groundwater-sustainability service; downloaded and verified by executor-remote-http

semantics.description: Platform-generated secret-free success receipt recording operationType, serviceId, apiVersion, serviceVersion, modelVersion, remoteTaskId, requestSha256, idempotencyKey, inputs with size/SHA256, valuesSha256, artifacts with media type/format/size/SHA256, status, remote termination confirmation and remoteReceiptSha256.
limitations: Integrity is not scientific validation: the receipt proves the platform-observed request, versions and returned bytes, not the correctness or reproducibility of the external scoring method.
The receipt is produced only after confirmed success and contains no API key, credential value, CA secret or service base URL.
